description.value: Royal Crown Pizza is a family-owned pizzeria that has operated in New Westminster since 2012, offering a broad menu of specialty and supreme pizzas with locally inspired flavour combinations alongside wings, salads, lasagna, and samosas. The shop has indoor seating and actively caters to businesses, schools, and events of any size. Reviewers consistently highlight friendly staff, a clean shop, and the option to grab a slice on the go.
